zoe: Heads-up — onboarding sample app (TS + rollup/vite variants) surfaced two annoying issues in the edge preview: (1) `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` when the SDK is bundled into the worker, and (2) Authorization header missing when our server does an internal proxy/rewrite to /internal-api. Repro is tiny. Anyone seen this pattern?

nate: yes, seen both. Bundlers often remove Node shims; edge runtimes don't provide Buffer. For the auth case, many platform rewrites drop credentials unless you explicitly forward headers on the internal fetch.

zoe: repro notes I used: ESM package.json (type: 'module'), import SDK with `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`, and rollup + vite builds where we force-bundle the sdk to avoid external resolution. Preview steps: build -> preview -> curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' /api/proxy -> upstream missing auth.

omar: actionable fixes: SDK should lazily guard for Buffer (`if (typeof Buffer === 'undefined') { const { Buffer } = await import('buffer/'); globalThis.Buffer = Buffer }`). That avoids forcing polyfills on every consumer. Also log a non-fatal warning referencing devex docs when Buffer is missing so users see guidance.

ivy: on the auth side, sample snippet for edge handler: `const proxied = new Request(targetUrl, { method: req.method, headers: req.headers, body: req.body }); await fetch(proxied)` — that preserves Authorization on Vercel/Fastly-like platforms. Add this to quickstart.

nate: also typings parity: TypeScript consumers with `esModuleInterop: false` see different import shapes. Recommend we ship a d.ts that supports both default and namespace imports (compat `export =` shim).

zoe: bundler tips for docs: Vite - `ssr.noExternal: ['redwood-inference']` + `optimizeDeps.include: ['buffer']`. Rollup - alias `buffer` -> `buffer/` and include @rollup/plugin-node-resolve. Webpack - `resolve.fallback: { buffer: require.resolve('buffer/') }`. Include a tiny example repo for each.

omar: I'll open a small SDK PR to add the lazy Buffer import + runtime warning. Also add a small types patch. ETA 48h.

ci-bot: created issue RF-402: "edge sdk: buffer guard + proxy header guidance"

ivy: temporary customer workaround: at top of edge entry `globalThis.Buffer = globalThis.Buffer || (await import('buffer/')).Buffer` and ensure proxy code forwards headers. We'll add this to onboarding docs ASAP.

zoe: I'll attach the private repro and add a CI preview job that curls /api/proxy so we catch regressions. Thanks team.
